title: a system-door delete faults with sys_recycle_bin.organization_id NOT NULL when the record carries no organization_id
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTyMahdAdhXSzgy2nt

Filing gate: ① product defect · Source: fleet · out-of-scope finding of the #35640 measurement (readings 7023666050, kind K7), filed on the seat's order after its fable review. ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: left to triage. The seat's review suggests **p2**: a platform fault, not specific to one driver. Reach: measured through `os verify --delete-behaviors` (system door) on `bootStack`.

## Business reason

A delete through the system door (`runAs: 'system'`, which flows, hooks and admin tooling use) of a record that has no `organization_id` fails instead of moving the record to the recycle bin. Such records include those of an object with `tenancy: { enabled: false }`, and any row the mongodb driver wrote, since it does not stamp one. The delete is lost, and the caller gets a database constraint error.

## What happens

`os verify --delete-behaviors` on a fixture whose objects carry no `organization_id` (tenancy disabled) reported 6 system-door faults with `NOT NULL constraint failed: sys_recycle_bin.organization_id`. This happened identically on a `memory` datasource and on a real mongod. The REST-door deletes of the same records held. The fault is the recycle-bin write, which copies the record's `organization_id` into a column that refuses null.

## Expected

A system-door delete of a record with no `organization_id` either lands in the recycle bin with the org the context supplies, or is recorded under a rule the recycle bin states for global records. It never fails on the constraint.

## Done when

A test deletes a `tenancy: { enabled: false }` record through the system door, and the delete succeeds with the record recoverable from the recycle bin (or the stated rule holds), on memory and on a SQL store.

Who acts: the owner of the recycle bin (`sys_recycle_bin`) and the system delete path (triage routes).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open recycle bin organization_id` (2026-11-19 22:2xZ): no match (#35640, #35488 and #33631 are unrelated).
